name: present
description: Surfaces a decision to the human and returns the pick, so an agent or module never prints 'please choose' to stdout and parses free text back
input: a message and a list of options, either as flags or as json on stdin with --json
output: the selected option on stdout, or json {selected:[...]} or {cancelled:true} with --json

cost.detail: local binary, no network, no api
